zh-TW: 營業活動的現金流量統計
營業活動之淨現金流量
en: Net cash from (used in) operating activities

note.zh-TW: 模板原文寫「營業活動的現金流量統計」，「統計」是「總計」的用詞錯誤；網站顯示修正寫法，模板原字列為別名。
note.en: The template label uses a wrong word for total; the site shows the corrected wording and keeps the original as a searchable alias.

definition.zh-TW: 本業在這段期間淨收到（或淨付出）的現金。它是現金流量三項指標的分子，長期為正表示公司本業能自己造血。
definition.en: The net cash the main business brought in (or paid out) during the period. It is the numerator of the three cash flow ratios; a persistently positive figure means the business funds itself.
